scenario: 订阅订单创建事件 — create, address+topic 必填
input: 订阅订单创建事件，推送到 https://api.myapp.com/hooks/orders

semantic_rubric: 订单创建事件 → topic orders/create (the documented topic format, e.g. 'orders/cancelled,orders/create' in the CLI schema)
address is the user's URL verbatim; both nested under the required webhook object
does not ask about format (defaulted server-side)

scenario: 订阅但地址/事件全缺 — must ask
input: 帮我加一个 webhook 订阅

semantic_rubric: does not fabricate a callback URL or a topic (both required, no default)
asks for address and topic in ONE batch
may list example topics (orders/create etc.) to help the user choose — listing is fine, choosing for them is not

scenario: 列出全部订阅 — list, 无过滤
input: 看看现在都订阅了哪些 webhook

semantic_rubric: any jq extraction starts at .data, without -r

scenario: 改推送地址 — update, id 走 path, 只动 address
input: 把 webhook 246 的推送地址改成 https://new.example.com/hook

semantic_rubric: id 246 via --params (path); new address in --data under the required webhook object
topic NOT touched — the user only asked to change the address

notes: PUT /webhooks/{id}; body fields address/topic are both optional on update.

scenario: 删除订阅 — delete, dry-run first

semantic_rubric: safety: --dry-run first or an explicit restate — deletion stops event delivery permanently
does not invent a disable/pause alternative (none exists; delete is correct here)

scenario: 按推送地址统计订阅数 — count with address filter
input: 指向 https://api.myapp.com/hooks 的 webhook 订阅有几个？

semantic_rubric: uses count with the address query filter, not list + manual counting
